## What's Changed
• Scope inventory search to user-facing fields and make the low-disk warning actionable by @ngsevers in https://github.com/celerp/celerp/pull/308
• Write off stock in one step, with a dedicated shrinkage account by @ngsevers in https://github.com/celerp/celerp/pull/314
• Close a settled memo and show per-line shipped state by @ngsevers in https://github.com/celerp/celerp/pull/315
• fix：merged item barcodes were matching to barcode activities by @ngsevers in https://github.com/celerp/celerp/pull/316
• Remove the Team card from relay picker by @ngsevers in https://github.com/celerp/celerp/pull/309
• Search inventory by a named field, and by a per-piece measure by @ngsevers in https://github.com/celerp/celerp/pull/317
• Load large lists and documents without stalling by @ngsevers in https://github.com/celerp/celerp/pull/318
